reviews.text: I appreciate all the staff for taking a look at my (stray) kitty. I was very stressed out and worried, but for now being able to have reassurance and understanding of what may be going on with her as well as treatment helped us so much! Thank You Dr. Pappan and all the staff at Petworks Express.
Friendly staff and affordable.

TL;DR: Unprofessional and misquotes costs of services

Background info:
I originally chose this clinic because they were “low cost” and conveniently located.  Dr. Pappan had commented during a surgery consult that he would check my dog thoroughly during surgery to see if there were any more growths that would need to be removed during that surgery. Upon receiving the printed out quote for the surgery, I asked Dr Pappan (who was at the front desk) if there would be additional charges for the removal of any additional growths found, to which he replied that he would not charge more because “he is a rescued dog” which I thought was very kind of him and thanked him profusely for that.

After the surgery, upon checkout, a great difference in the price came to light.  When I showed the front desk person the print out of my original quote, he went in the back to talk to Dr. Pappan and then he came back to the front desk and adjusted the total amount due, which I paid using two credit cards.  I still ended up paying over $100 more than what was originally quoted, but at that point I was just grateful that they brought the final price down some.  Upon giving me my receipt, the front desk person pointed where it said that $40.86 was still due and said that he would fix it in the system (in hindsight, maybe I should’ve asked him to write on the bill “paid in full” and sign it). Then I was given my dog and we left.

The reason for this review:
My husband brought our dog in for his next visit to get seasonal allergy medication (a drug that had been previously given to us by a rescue group, so a simple exam, more on that later).  Dr Pappan walked into the exam room and immediately wrongly accused us of “refusing to pay the bill” on our previous visit.

When my husband asked what the amount was, Dr. Pappan said it was $40.86 and rudely stated “We don’t work here for free”.  My husband then said he would call me to figure out was going on because it didn’t make sense to him that I would refuse to pay $40.83 while paying hundreds of dollars for the surgery.  Dr. Pappan then stepped into the hallway while my husband called me.  I quickly explained over the phone what had transpired during checkout at the last visit and we got off the phone.

My husband then overheard Dr. Pappan respond loudly to a staff member who seemed to be trying to explain what had happened, “Now, why would I agree to that?!”

So to avoid dispute, because Dr. Pappan clearly wasn’t willing to discuss the issue further, my husband stepped out of the exam room and went to the front desk and just paid the $40.86 and also pre-paid for that day’s visit.  He ended up paying more than what I was told the simple exam fee would be on the phone (he paid $52 for a “comprehensive exam” fee, I was quoted $32 the day before).

We have been a part of the Houston area’s dog and cat rescue community for decades.  We have never experienced a doctor that was as unprofessional, rude and money-focused as Dr. Papan was with us.  His behavior over a $40.86 billing mistake on their part, while still getting paid more than I was quoted, is mind-boggling. We have used more expensive vets in the past and they were always transparent about their fees and treated us respectfully.  After four visits to this office, we are transferring to a different vet.

I wish I had paid closer attention to the other negative reviews when researching this vet.

The vet was very rough with my kitten and was dismissive of all the concerns we had. He gave her too much dewormer and was argumentative with us about the age we knew she was. He was extremely condescending when he spoke. We also waited three hours for our service just to be rushed out like we didn’t matter. Do not recommend coming here.
Every visit is so comfortable.
Low-cost services

As someone who works in the veterinary industry, I have never experienced such a lack of professionalism, integrity, or practice of proper medicine. Long story short, these people are frauds.

My cat supposedly got an ear polyp removal surgery here a few years ago. He continued to have chronic ear infections and issues to the point where my current veterinarian was concerned for another ear polyp, prompting us to look at his records from this clinic. These medical records include a photo of a cat with a visable ear polyp. That was very clearly some random cat, looking nothing like my cat. My cats ear polyp was also not visible, but deep in his ear. The records also clearly stated that no polyp was found during the surgery, which clearly contradicts what the doctor told me, as well as the $600 line item I paid for for an ear polyp removal.

When I contacted the office and was finally able to speak with the practice manager Betty, after multiple attempts, she did not listen. Eventually when she did begin to listen to what I had to say she said she was busy working on paperwork and would talk to the doctor later. I then got a email requesting that I bring my cat in to verify his microchip information. I told them it was correct and sent proof of that, as well as telling them that I now live an hour away and that was not feasible for me. After multiple follow ups of both calling and texting, I finally got an email response insisting that I bring my cat in, uncaring that I had proof of microchip and that I lived an hour away and worked during the week. I asked for a call from Dr. Pappan himself or a refund for the $600 service that I paid for and was not provided. After multiple calls and emails on my part following up, they ghosted me.

My cat continued to get sick and worsen due to this ear polyp, to the point where I had to put him to sleep. Please do not use the vet. Not only is Dr. Pappan and this clinic making grotesque mistakes with your pets care, but they have zero remorse for their actions.

Found this vet on Reddit and the people don’t lie! Dr.Pappan is very nice and professional. You can tell he genuinely cares for the animals. We found a kitten on a road with a fractured leg, the first vet we took him to referred us to GCVS and they quoted us $7000 over the phone without even checking out the kitten’s actual condition. Took the kitten to Petworks and Dr.Pappan offered a better solution that saved us $7000! The kitten is healing on his own, thriving and running. With that being said, I highly recommend Petworks Express. They actually want your pets to get better and not just hurting your pocket.

I have to say this clinic is terrible to say the least. For starters the receptionist is extremely rude barely allowing me anytime to talk and making me wait for a long time despite the fact that I already had an appointment scheduled. The office manager herself was also rude as when I asked for more knowledge on trying to learn how I could help my pet she said the first thing i required was common sense to function as a pet owner in an extremely condescending and belittling tone. The doctor has to be the most arrogant and unprofessional man I’ve ever come across. They say old age grants you wisdom but this man only has arrogance in him. Only caring about money and wanting me out of the clinic with no clear indication of trying to help me. Also to anyone asking for surgeries on the clinic I would advise against it here. It is common practice to do surgeries in the morning so that they have the rest of the day to fully recover. But instead this arrogant doctor performs surgeries around past mid day and then immediately calling the owners with little to no check up time on the pets recovery. I myself wouldn’t feel comfortable letting my pet have only an hour or two of rest as apposed to the many hours a morning surgery can offer. And any surgery done seems rushed with hardly any anesthesia, meaning they can feel the pain in their body as surgery is being done one them. I wouldn’t advise going to this place as the staff and the doctor are nothing but people who look out for themselves with little regard to a pets safety or life. To anyone also seeking employment here find somewhere else. If you think that doctor is there to teach you and treat you with common courtesy and respect think again
Love this pet clinic!
This place has very little compassion for animals and zero value for their lives. HORRIBLE staff that is extremely rude and unprofessional. save yourself the time and trouble
They really take care of my dogs. Very nice personal.

This clinic is incredibly disrespectful. A man who answered the phone was extremely rude and racist. I called to ask a question, and his attitude and arrogant manner left me speechless. I can speak a little English, but the question I needed to ask had to be asked in Spanish because my dog ​​has a delicate condition that requires surgery. The rude man told me no, that no one there speaks Spanish at any time of day. That response was just awful. The man—I wish I had his name—was so unpleasant. I will never call again because it's not the only clinic in Houston, and I would never recommend it. The service was TERRIBLE 🤬

I can’t say enough good things about Dr. Pappan and the entire team—they were truly a godsend. From the moment I walked through the door, I could feel the difference compared to other clinics I’d visited. The staff is not only incredibly caring but also efficient and professional.
Dr. Pappan is exceptionally knowledgeable and trustworthy. Thanks to their expertise, my cat's condition turned around completely. They knew exactly what steps to take for a full recovery.
Just the day before, another clinic had made me feel like euthanizing my 3-year-old cat might be the only option. I’m so grateful I trusted my instincts and brought my cat here instead.
I will recommend this clinic to anyone who will listen. I’ve finally found a place where I feel completely confident and comfortable bringing both my cat and my dog.
The entire staff is kind, fast and responsive. They take care of you and your pets with love.
Thank you, much appreciated

Found them via online low-cost clinic list. Was kind of cautious from the other reviews on here, but they are all very very friendly/informative!

They really know how to take care of animals. Dogs/cats included! Front desk receptionist is super friendly and the vet assistant is very helpful. Loved the doctor as well. I did have to reschedule once, because I was late for the drop off time for surgeries, but that’s on me! I absolutely adored that they took in a stray cat in replacement of my absence! Every minute matters and I give them respect for that.

Anyway I didn’t want to write a review until she was all healed up, but my Maltese (3 years old) female got spayed. Her recovery was great. It was sad that I had to stop her from any activity so she could heal properly, but totally worth it. I advise you to take 2-3 weeks off or make time to watch your baby heal. They will be extra clingy during recovery, so if you leave they will jump/whine etc which is not good. I think they did a great job with the surgery, super fast too. Dropped her off at 8:30-9am and picked her up at 11-12. No visible scar after 3 weeks now post surgery. Can’t beat the prices here either. 10/10 will be back for future services!
I recommend it 100%
Our team and I are very grateful for your kind reply. Thank you. Dr. Pappan
The only place that I bring my pets to Update 2025: Dr Pappan and his staff are truly amazing! Still the only place I trust with my animals

I luv this place the front desk lady is so sweet she always has time for any questions I have. I belong to a pug name Chanel 😂 and they are so patient with her with all her barking 😞 don't know any place better and I been to a few. …
The doctor was very professional and the service was good，

The staff at PetWorks truly embody a remarkable sense of grace and patience, a gift that seems to come straight from God. My dog, King, can be quite anxious and barks loudly, but they were so understanding and accommodating. They swiftly placed us in a room to help prevent any disruptions for the other dogs, which I deeply appreciated. King can be overwhelming at times, but their kindness made me feel truly welcomed and valued.

The customer service we received was outstanding, and as we prepare for his upcoming surgery, I have complete confidence that he will be in loving and capable hands. It’s clear that they care for all fur babies and their families, even those with spirited personalities like King! I am incredibly grateful for this compassionate business and pray that God showers everyone involved with abundant blessings and rewards for their kindness. Thank you for everything!
They took good care of my dog.

I recommend this place it's convenient and well established good customer support and friendly staff .I'm confident my dog is in good hands having surgery this week .I will keep petworks express my place .to bring my dogor cat . reasonable prices great service.

I am appalled and distressed by the grossly inadequate care I received during my 4-hour wait. The nursing staff's lack of knowledge and clear direction was staggering, and the overall unprofessionalism displayed by the entire staff was completely unacceptable.
As a patient, I expect a basic level of competence, empathy, and respect. Instead, I was met with a shocking display of ineptitude and indifference. I demand a full investigation into this matter and immediate action to address the systemic failures that led to this disastrous experience.
Nice people, quick and outstanding service.
Excellent service, very professional. They saved my pet and helped me in Spanish. The prices are fair.

EDIT: Grumbledore is still alive and happy. Steroid pills were all he needed and this vet pressured me into trying to end his life. Y’all should be ashamed.

I came here because I thought it was the same as pet express, it’s not. Although there was no wait and the receptionist were very nice the “cat expert” vet was pressuring me to put my 2 year old cat down because of allergies because she didn’t think he was worth treating. She kept asking me if I thought there was a point to help my pet. He was a former feral and they did charge me a lovely handling fee so I do understand that he’s difficult for to handle, but her bed side manner sucked. Telling a new patient a 2 year old cat should be put down for allergies is pretty strange. Then I paid almost $300 for medicine that didn’t even help him. She thought his issues were serious enough to put him down, but couldn’t prescribe something that would actually help. I’m thinking she just wasn’t familiar with his issues or how to treat him so she thought what she considered a feral wasn’t worth the trouble. Went to my usual vet and paid half of that and my cat is totally back to normal. Would never recommend this spot or their “cat expert vet”. Really awful experience here.
Highly recommend!!!Dr.Pappan and staff are nice and professional.
Excellent service! I loved it. The doctor was very kind and explained everything thoroughly. The clinic staff were also very friendly. Get your pet checked out! 🐾 …

Very satisfied with the service I received the staff was courteous and professional,and they did a spectacular job on his nails , thanks for all you do in the pet care community, from one appreciative customer

Front desk worker young girl with glasses and older white lady completely unprofessional, rude and nasty attitudes. I waited for over 4 hours for my pet to be seen and then an extra hour just to check out and pay.  It was a great clinic but this is unexceptable. Rather pay a little more for better service than this trash! Never again!
You have the wrong clinic! We have no one in our system  by that name. Reconsider your post, thanks
